title: Factor
text: We need to find a pair of numbers so that $$\left(x+a\right) \left(x+b\right)=x^2+6x+8$$.

title: Rules for coefficients
text: We find coefficients such that $$ab=8$$ and $$a+b=6$$

title: Rules for coefficients
text: This works for $$a=2$$ and $$b=4$$ since the product is $$8$$ and the sum is $$6$$. One way to find this is to consider all interger factors of $$8$$ and then try the sums: 1,8 and 2,4 are the only possible factors. $$1+8=9$$ and $$2+4=6$$.
